description: Freeze a mapping plan into a pinned adapter: every mapping is stamped as frozen so the same input maps the same way every time with no model call. Pass plan from plan_rosetta_mapping. Returns the adapter; nothing is stored. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

plan.description: A plan as plan_rosetta_mapping returns it.

source_schema_id.description: The source the plan maps from.

target_schema_id.description: The schema the plan maps onto.

tier.description: The trust tier of the suggester.

name: freeze_rosetta_adapter
